Sustainability & Environment

We take responsibility. For your skin. And our planet.

Learn more about our sustainability program

We are committed to continually improving the environmental footprint of our products.
Environmental Impact
Compared to other face care products sold in the European market
Together with over 70 cosmetics companies & associations we have developed a science-based environmental impact assessment and scoring system.  Products that score “A” rank amongst the best in class of the face care category for having a lower environmental impact. Products that score “E” have a higher impact and are therefore key products to focus our efforts to improve their environmental performance.

About

Eucerin® Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care Dry Skin Immediately soothes skin sensitivity and restores skin comfort. Pleasant skin feeling with less skin tightness.
NART: 69745-09900-08

Read more about our product

Eucerin® Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care Dry Skin

Immediately soothes skin sensitivity and restores skin comfort. Pleasant skin feeling with less skin tightness.

Contains SymSitive, active ingredient developed for hypersensitive skin, that effectively acts as a sensitivity regulator directly at the source of the

hyperreactivity, instantly calming the skin.

 - Soothes skin sensitiveness longlastingly

 - The skin is optimally moisturized

 - Skin feels smooth and supple

Very good efficacy and tolerability on hypersensitive skin.

0% Alcohol and Fragrances

How to Use

Apply daily in the morning on well cleansed face, by gently massaging into the skin. Visibly red areas might require more product. - Fast absorbing - Easy to spread

Main findings

*Self-assessment study with 53 women, 4 weeks of regular use
Proven Results*
Improvement in skin sensitivity and reactivity

Clinical Formula

SymSitive

SymSitive* is a soothing ingredient designed for sensitive skin. Its unique neurosensory action provides both immediate and long-lasting relief from discomforts like stinging, burning, and itching, helping to calm and protect the skin.

*registered trademark of Symrise, Germany

FAQ

Should I use Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care for dry skin?

Yes. If you have hypersensitive dry skin and want a gentle but effective day and/or night cream use Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care.

Can I use Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care if I have hypersensitive normal to combination skin?

If you have hypersensitive normal to combination skin and want a gentle but effective day and/or night cream. Try Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care Normal to combination skin.

If you have hypersensitive normal to combination skin and want a gentle but effective day and/or night cream. Try Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care Normal to combination skin.

Try Eucerin Anti-Redness Concealing Day Care SPF 30.

Can I use Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care if I have redness but don't need SPF protection?

Try Eucerin Anti-Redness Soothing Care.
